newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - price hike quietens trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - price hike quietens trade.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel mirrored crude futures which soared on bullish Iraqi news before edging back. But the price rise slowed activity.

Cargoes prices were put around $135-140 fob NWE, although no deals were heard done. Some dealers said straight-run was now more attactive against crude, while others thought the strong gas oil and gasoline prices would incline buyers towards crude to maximise these product outputs.
High sulphur fuel failed to capitalise on the generally stronger energy complex due to good supplies. E-4 was assessed at formula +$2.50-4.00, M-100 at two means +2-3.
